description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_UserAgent_Console, which extends Zend_Http_UserAgent_Desktop, and provides functionality for identifying console-based user agents in the Zend Framework's HTTP component. It includes methods to match user agents against known console signatures and to get the browser type.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Console
classes.description: A class for identifying console user agents by extending the Desktop user agent class and matching known signatures.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Checks if the user agent and server info match console signatures.
